name: lwh
description: Skills that help people plan, build and test real apps with Claude Code, learning as they go.

plugins.name: lwh-core
plugins.description: Run any list of tasks to completion with a chain of worker subagents, and stop a run cleanly at any time.

plugins.name: lwh-ai-coding
plugins.description: Plan an app, stress-test the plan, split it into tested tasks, and security-check the result. Installs lwh-core to run the tasks.
